verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap is a transcription API, and scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a job-based API service, so the axis applies. However, its documentation only covers creating one-off transcription jobs via URL or upload, with webhook and SSE updates; it never mentions any scheduling or recurrence feature. The Google Drive automations (docs-24, docs-25) run on Zapier, a host platform, and are event-triggered rather than scheduled, so they earn no credit here.
